state_machine.raid: trade beyond liquidity by 1 or 3 bp with aggressive flow toward the raid and completed close back inside
state_machine.rejection_block: terminal wick between raid extreme and candle body edge, with minimum wick/body ratio 1 or 2
state_machine.confirmation: opposite completed displacement of at least 2 or 5 bp with aligned aggressive flow
state_machine.entry_confirmation: first later retest of body edge, midpoint or 75-percent wick depth that closes back outside the block
state_machine.entry: next exact bar's executable ask for long or bid for short
state_machine.exit: stop, target, completed block invalidation, or terminal NAV mark

economics.winner_removal: remove top 10 percent of positive 12bp event keys before complete rerouting

prohibitions: no risk rescue of negative expectancy
